title: Modified vector generators can truncate canonical fixtures in place
description: test/vectors/generate.py, generate_authenticated_schc_dio.py, and generate_packets_timing.py write canonical JSON with Path.write_text. A crash/write error can leave a truncated fixture; the timing generator can also update one of its two outputs before failing on the second. Add a shared same-directory atomic JSON writer using fsync+replace, preserve existing mode, clean temporary files on failure, and test failure preserves the prior destination.
